finding: The `/ai` Route is not wrapped in `<FeatureFlipper feature="AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY">`. The spec (section 4) explicitly requires: 'Wrap the new route in `<FeatureFlipper feature="AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY">`.' The constraints section requires: 'All three new UI surfaces (nav item, tab, callout) must be wrapped in FeatureFlipper or gated via useFeatureFlipper checking "AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY". When the feature is disabled... the `/ai` route must redirect to `/overview`.' The `possiblePaths` conditional gating via `isAiEnabled` prevents the redirect loop (which is correct), but the Route itself is unconditionally rendered in the Switch. A user who manually navigates to the `/ai` path (bookmark, URL bar, browser history) when the feature flag is off will see the full PlatoTab rendered. The route must be wrapped in FeatureFlipper.
spec_ref: Spec section 4 (JobApplicationContainer.tsx changes): 'Wrap the new route in `<FeatureFlipper feature="AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY">`'; Spec 'Feature flag gating' constraint: 'the `/ai` route must redirect to `/overview`'

finding: useAiJobApplicationSummary is called unconditionally, passing `aiJobApplicationSummaryId: aiSummary?.id || 0`. The spec requires lazy fetching: 'use the shallow `aiJobApplicationSummary` from the `jobApplication` object for status checks, then fetch the full data only when status is `succeeded` and the rich layout needs rendering.' When no summary exists (empty/no-resume states) or status is not `succeeded` (generating/processing/failed states), this fires an API request to `/job_applications/{id}/ai_job_application_summaries/0` -- a nonexistent resource that will 404. This happens on every render of PlatoTab regardless of state, wasting a network round-trip and producing console errors in 5 of the 6 tab states. The hook's underlying `useQuery` accepts an `enabled` option that should be used to prevent the fetch.
spec_ref: Spec 'AI summary data fetching' pattern: 'use the shallow `aiJobApplicationSummary`... then fetch the full data only when status is `succeeded`'
fix: Either modify useAiJobApplicationSummary to accept and forward an `enabled` option to useQuery, or pass `enabled: status === 'succeeded' && !!aiSummary?.id` directly. The hook should not fire when there is no succeeded summary.

finding: platoNavLinkStyles does not include a `label:` property for Emotion debugging. The spec's 'Emotion styled component conventions' section requires: 'Every styled component must have a `label` property for debugging. The label format is `ParentComponentName_StyledElementName`.' PlatoNavLabel correctly has `label: JobApplicationSidebar_PlatoNavLabel` (line 473), but PlatoNavItem (the NavLink wrapper, created at line 470 via `styled(NavLink, ...)(platoNavLinkStyles)`) lacks one. The original `NavItem.tsx` `linkStyles` also lacks a label, but the spec requires labels on all styled components in the new code -- replicating a pre-existing gap does not satisfy the spec.
spec_ref: Spec 'Emotion styled component conventions': 'Every styled component must have a `label` property for debugging. The label format is `ParentComponentName_StyledElementName`.'
fix: Add `label: JobApplicationSidebar_PlatoNavItem;` as the first line inside the platoNavLinkStyles template string.
